go mod verify and production build

verifiedBehavior: Span groups combine legacy transaction children and standalone v2 spans with continuous p95 and accumulated duration.
Compatible responses expose exactly the public span-group fields and accept total-time, average-duration or count ordering.
Repeated project filters must all remain inside the current membership and Bearer project grant.
N+1 patterns aggregate repeated child operations per trace and then by transaction, child operation and description.
The child operation prefix, finite threshold, time window, limit and query admission are enforced.
Session, event:read Bearer and anonymous denial paths all use real PostgreSQL telemetry.
